unresolved: All other contexts, including source_sha256 outside the specified receipt bindings, record_sha256 outside text-layer bindings, payload_sha256, enclosing transaction identities, raw file and line hashes, dynamic map keys and external stores require producer-specific classification.
PostgreSQL, immutable runtime stores, archived verifiers, D1 and compressed artifacts are outside the tracked JSON/JSONL scan.
The tracked census still has unclassified field families and dynamic map keys. Their producer and input bytes require individual tracing; inventory output records their occurrence groups.
The generic sha256 field appears in file custody, content fingerprints, payload bindings and other contexts. Split each location by producer and exact input before classification.
text_layer_sha256 outside the classified anchor contexts requires tracing of the producing text-layer binding.
source_sha256 and revision in other contexts require their producing command or external artifact to distinguish canonical inputs from exact bytes.
Dynamic field names outside classified source_contracts require their owning maps and producer inputs.
